intent: Individually authored tasks distinguish real evidence, direction, specificity and privacy without unsupported inferences.
picturePurpose: Exact coded entrance orientation and fictional public-post redaction explain relations; no image is used to infer actual material or private ownership.

items.label: false：false alarm说明什么？
items.material: A false alarm interrupted the rehearsal.
items.reason: false表示错误的或假的，false alarm是误报或虚惊。原句仍说明这次误报打断了排练，不能改成完全没影响，也不能凭此断定发生了真实紧急事件。没有给出误报原因或准确持续时间。

items.label: specific：specific example要从哪里找？

transfer.stem: Which notes preserve the entrance direction, the text evidence and the public-post rule?
transfer.passage:
A school information display
Our class prepared an information display in a hall. The main entrance faced the square. One model used real stones from the river; that information came from the maker’s note, not simply from the way the stones looked.
A leaflet gave general advice about safe cycling. Our teacher asked for a specific example from the text. We had to point to something the text actually said instead of inventing an unrelated example. For a fictional public-post exercise, we kept the event information but covered the fields marked as personal contact details. Nothing was published.
A note about a nearby path said that it crossed private land. It did not say that every path in the area was closed. Later, a false alarm interrupted our rehearsal; the alarm did not confirm a real emergency. We also kept a surprise party a secret, but that did not mean that nobody could ever find out about it.

options.text: The entrance faces the square; a specific example must come from the text; personal details should stay out of the public post.
Every entrance faces away from the square; an invented example is enough; all private contact details should be published.
The entrance faces the square; an invented example is enough; personal details should stay out of the public post.
The entrance faces the square; a specific example must come from the text; all private contact details should be published.

answer.display: The entrance faces the square; a specific example must come from the text; personal details should stay out of the public post.
